content: Wait. What are you doing with that soft tomato?
I'll take it, and I'll take that hard bread, too.
Stop, you can't get that out of the trash.
I'm trying to do my part to reduce food waste. And these vegetables are still OK to eat.
Fine, but they've been thrown away.
What are you going to do with that meat that doesn't look fresh?
I'm going to throw that away, too.
I'll take it. I'm sure I can make something eatable with it.
You can't be serious. I can't bear eating that kind of spoiled meat.
It doesn't go bad, it's just beyond the freshness.
Well, please, you can have all of the food.
And to show my thanks, I'll invite you to lunch tomorrow.
